scope: Standing Thewalai Khanet in Sanam Chandra Palace, including its tall shaped concrete platform, open four-sided pavilion, domed canopy, crown finial and simplified bronze Ganesha figure facing Bhimarn Prathom.
state: native outline, public terrain and written architecture verified

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The survey identifies a high platform, domed concrete roof with Lopburi influence and brass ornaments. The enshrined figure faces toward Bhimarn Prathom.
The palace guardian shrine stands on the lawn in front of Bhimarn Prathom and houses the Ganesha figure.
The historic audience axis aligns the central shrine with Bhimarn Prathom and Phra Pathom Chedi.
Primary historical research identifies the enshrined figure as cast bronze and records the 1919 consecration.

next: Build and render the raised open sanctuary, domed canopy and west-facing bronze figure.
